episode_summary: In this episode, Kim Rittberg emphasizes the importance of integrating personal content into social media strategies to boost engagement and build connections. She highlights the ongoing relevance of video content and provides actionable tips for repurposing videos across platforms. The episode also discusses maintaining client relationships and credibility through personal engagement and showcasing client successes.
